pool.policy: Terrestrial low bodies and complete plant/prop footprints reserve the whole bank rectangle. Existing bank rocks may frame the water only beyond a conservative full-footprint ellipse and actual dry-water checks. Tree crowns may overhang.
pool.placement_contract: Tree bodies retain full bank reserve; dry-bank props use conservative full-footprint ellipse clearance plus 5x5 actual local-water checks.

validation_scope: Actual GLB triangle/2.2m plane intersections for trees, full prop bounds, exact CPU atlas/local-water query, tree-body bank reserve plus conservative full-prop dry-bank ellipse clearance, dry footprint samples, 5m clear arrival/1.5m pool camera, preserved sources. Crowns may overhang. Native capsule/render/performance validation is independent.
